reported.title: Settle filter can be starved by repeated short glitches, missing genuine presses
reported.description: In scanStart() the debounce timer rawChangedAt is reset on every raw level change (lines 41-45), and the press is only accepted once the level has been stable for SETTLE_MS (line 46). Repeated sub-20 ms LOW glitches every ~19 ms keep resetting rawChangedAt so the settled-down condition at line 49 never becomes true, and the measured evidence shows D10 missed 4 of 5 triggers, e.g. 'D10 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 530 ms'. D10 missed 4 of 5 trigger(s): D10 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 530 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Zone valve relay on D10; start button on D6 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D6 opens the valve (D10 HIGH) for 500 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 12 ms on press and release must not start a second burst.
- Presses while the valve is open are ignored and do not extend it.
- The valve stays closed (D10 LOW) whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `zone n=<count>` every 1000 ms.
